input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds us. Section 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) contains only compliance, access-control, content and anti-spam covenants, and Section 7 is limited to unsolicited e-mail; nothing restricts the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. Section 2(a) affirmatively preserves our freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software and services (subject only to TrueLink's IP and our confidentiality obligations), which exceeds the playbook's preferred position. The "ordinary course of business" wording in Section 2(a) defines the scope of the licence granted to us rather than restricting our other activities. The only non-competition reference (Section 8(d)) makes TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data subject to a separate Non-Competition Agreement, i.e. a limitation on the vendor, which is acceptable; we should nonetheless review that separate agreement to confirm it imposes no restraint on us. No redline required.
